title: Plans
empty: Start with a floorplan (an image of the building) or a distribution board.
deleteMessage: Delete plan "{{name}}" with its zones and products? This cannot be undone.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.imageHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 20 MB. Drop it here, choose a file or paste it.
dialog.replaceHint: Optional. Products and zones keep their place on the new image.

editor.title: Plan
editor.readOnlyProject: This project is completed or cancelled: the plan can only be viewed.
editor.phoneHint: Plans are edited on larger screens. Here you can view the plan and its products.

zones.name: Name
zones.shortNameHint: Up to 12 characters, used on channel labels. Empty: derived from the name.
zones.cornerHint: Drag a corner to move it, drag or click an edge's middle dot to add one, Alt-click a corner to remove it.
zones.countTitle: As last saved; the estimate in brackets counts the current drawing

palette.hint: Drag a product onto the plan, or click it and then the spot.
palette.armedHint: Click on the plan to place the product. Esc cancels.
palette.empty: The project's systems have no available products.
palette.noSystems: This project has no systems yet. Choose the systems you plan with to see their products.
palette.noneOnFloorplan: No products of the project's systems go on a floorplan.
palette.noneOnBoard: No products of the project's systems go on a board.

inspector.none: Select a product, zone or need symbol on the plan to see its details.
inspector.label: Label
inspector.existingHint: The customer already has it: counted technically, never invoiced
inspector.resizeAllHint_one: Size changes apply to the {{count}} placement of this product on the plan
inspector.resizeAllHint_other: Size changes apply to all {{count}} placements of this product on the plan

warning.variant_deleted: This product was deleted from the catalog.
warning.variant_inactive: This variant is inactive in the catalog.
warning.product_inactive: This product is inactive in the catalog.
warning.product_type_not_in_project: The system is not chosen for this project.
warning.required_addon_unavailable: A required add-on is not available.
warning.addon_unavailable: A chosen add-on is not available.
warning.addon_not_linked: A chosen add-on no longer belongs to this variant.
warning.module_width_unknown: The product's rail width is unknown: counted as 1 TE.
warning.module_mounting_floorplan: This product is not meant for a board.
warning.row_overflow: The module reaches beyond the row's capacity.
warning.enclosure_size_unknown: The enclosure's rows and TE per row are unknown: enter the rows yourself.
warning.module_overlap: The module overlaps another one (its width changed in the catalog): move it.

lock.heldBy: Being edited by {{name}} until {{time}}. You can view the plan.
lock.takenOver: {{name}} has taken over this plan. Changes not saved yet are lost; you can view it.
lock.readOnly: This project has been completed or cancelled in the meantime. You can view the plan; changes not saved yet are lost.

tools.zoneRect: Drag a rectangle on the plan.
tools.zonePolygon: Click the corners. Double-click, Enter or a click on the first corner closes the zone; Esc cancels.
tools.calibrate: Click two points whose real distance you know; Esc cancels.
tools.placeNeed: Click on the plan to place the need symbol; Esc cancels.
tools.placeNeedChoose: Choose the function of the symbol, then click on the plan; Esc cancels.

layers.hint: Hidden items are not shown, selectable or exported. This view is not saved.
layers.needsHint: Needs placed as symbols on the plan

calibrate.title: Calibrate scale
calibrate.pixels: The two points are {{px}} px apart on the image.
calibrate.invalid: Enter a distance above 0 in metres.

needs.title: Needs
needs.addHint: Choose a function to add a need to this zone.
needs.powerHint: In W, e.g. 7.5; empty if unknown
needs.label: Label
needs.applyTemplateHint: Adds the template's lines as needs of this zone.
needs.skipped_one: {{count}} line was skipped: its function or load type is inactive.
needs.skipped_other: {{count}} lines were skipped: their function or load type is inactive.
needs.symbolsHint_one: Plus {{count}} need symbol in this zone (edit it on the plan).
needs.symbolsHint_other: Plus {{count}} need symbols in this zone (edit them on the plan).
needs.noFunctionTypes: There are no active functions in the catalog.
needs.limit: A plan can have at most {{max}} needs: nothing was added.

needWarning.need_function_type_inactive: The function is inactive in the catalog.
needWarning.need_outside_zones: The symbol lies outside every zone.
needWarning.need_load_type_not_allowed: The function no longer allows this load type.

notice.copySkipped_one: {{count}} need symbol was not copied: its function or load type is inactive.
notice.copySkipped_other: {{count}} need symbols were not copied: their function or load type is inactive.
notice.zoneNeeds_one: {{count}} need was removed with its zone (Undo brings it back).
notice.zoneNeeds_other: {{count}} needs were removed with their zone (Undo brings them back).

boardDialog.name: Name
boardDialog.enclosureHint: An enclosure gives the rows and their width. Without one, enter the rows.

board.title: Board
board.noRows: This board has no rows yet. Add one on the Board tab.
board.enclosureHint: With an enclosure of known size the rows follow it: modules on rows it does not have move to the end of its last row (check them for overflow). Removing the enclosure keeps the rows.
board.fromEnclosure: The enclosure gives {{rows}} rows of {{te}} TE.
board.removeRowBusy: Row {{n}} has modules and cannot be removed
board.capacityInvalid: Above 0 and at most {{max}} TE, one decimal.
board.inspectorNone: Select a module on the board to see its details.
board.noRoom: There is no free space for it there.
board.copyRefused_one: {{count}} module found no free space and was not copied.
board.copyRefused_other: {{count}} modules found no free space and were not copied.
board.phoneHint: Boards are edited on larger screens. Here you can view the board.
board.paletteHint: Drag a product onto a rail, or click it and then the rail (or focus the rail and press Enter).
board.armedHint: Click a rail to place the product in the nearest free space. Esc cancels.
board.keyboardHint: A selected module: arrows move it (left/right by 0.5 TE, up/down to another row), Delete removes it, Ctrl+D duplicates.
board.enclosureExistingHint: The customer already has it: it is not in the bill of materials.
board.enclosureDeleted: The enclosure was deleted from the catalog. It stays on the board (and in the bill of materials as last saved) until you remove it.
board.enclosureRemoved: The deleted enclosure is removed with the next save.
board.channelsAfterSave: The channels can be connected once the module is saved.
